rule: A public number that is neither a date, an identifier, a contract-derived inventory count nor present in a bound source-traced record fails the public-literal audit, unless it is listed here as a method or tool constant with its reason. Each entry is route- and context-specific; it never allows a statistic.
inventory_counts_rule: An inventory count is allowed only where the audit recomputes it from the governed rows on every run; a mismatch fails the audit. It never allows a statistic.

inventory_counts.reason: The number of historical Findex measures for Yemen that the crosswalk maps: distinct hist_metric_id in the published-history rows of 26_FINDEX_HISTORY (40 rows, 36 measures, 2011 and 2014). The audit recounts it from the governed rows on every run, and a different count fails (close-out addendum item 1, 11 October 2026).
